A portion of this cell lysate was incubated with SiO2-PDMAEMA brushes, at a concentration of 5 mg/mL, for 30 min and the pellet was recovered by centrifugation at 3100 × g for 10 min. The pellets were washed with ice-cold PBS, pH 7.4 by centrifugation at 4 °C.

For interaction of SiO2-brush nanoparticles with cytosolic fractions (prepared as detailed above, by sequential centrifugation), we incubated SiO2-PDMAEMA and SiO2-PMETAC nanoparticles at a concentration of 5 mg/mL in undiluted cytosolic fractions, for 30 min.
